facts.text: The TabularMDP-v0 registration fixes num_states=10 and num_actions=5
The environment uses the legacy Gym API: it imports gym and gym.spaces and subclasses gym.Env
The action space is Discrete(num_actions), so a step action is an integer action index
The observation space is Box(0.0, 1.0, shape=(num_states,), dtype=float32)
The default task has uniform transition probabilities 1/num_states and zero mean rewards
seed replaces the environment's random generator and returns [seed]
sample_tasks draws transition rows from a Dirichlet(1) distribution and mean rewards from a Normal(1, 1) distribution
reset_task replaces the transition tensor and the mean rewards from a task dictionary
reset starts every episode in state 0 and returns a one-hot observation of length num_states
step draws the reward from a Normal(mean, 1) distribution, samples the next state from the transition row and returns the next one-hot observation
step always returns done=False, so the environment class itself never terminates an episode

determinism.notes: a reset with a seed, or cap.world.seed.v1 followed by a reset, reseeds the generator; the transition table and the mean rewards are fixed per task, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions. The clone draws from numpy's generator and this package's fake from Python's random.Random, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two. The clone's reset() takes no seed and does not consume the generator (mdp.py:57-63); the bridge seeds the legacy environment through seed() before reset()

gaps: analytic tabular MDP: a finite state transition table and a Normal reward, not a physical model; there are no dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise model beyond the reward distribution
the environment has no physics timestep: one step is one MDP transition and the class takes no time argument, so timestep_ms is 0 and ticks count transitions, not simulated time (FID-015)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, the state advances only when a command arrives
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

the registered TabularMDP-v0 adds gym's TimeLimit of 10 steps (maml_rl/envs/__init__.py:20); the fake models the environment class, whose step always returns done=False (mdp.py:75), so it does not truncate at 10 steps

the fake backend re-implements the tabular MDP in pure Python and was not compared with the upstream environment (neither gym nor gymnasium is importable where the gate runs): trajectories can differ from upstream's float32 arrays and numpy random stream
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
